hero.title: Your AI, your rules
hero.subtitle: Sentra Brain is the private AI server that puts control back in your hands.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.text: Using cloud-based AI means giving away your data, intellectual property, and exposing your clients. Regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or ISO27001 are clear: your data must remain under control.

solution.title: The Solution
solution.text: With Sentra Brain, install your own local or hybrid AI server, customizable and fully private. No external dependencies, no hidden fees.

benefit1.title: Total Privacy
benefit1.text: Your AI runs within your network. Fully compliant with GDPR, HIPAA and more.

benefit2.title: Flexible Integration
benefit2.text: Connect with CRM, ERP, n8n and your custom workflows.

benefit3.title: No Limits
benefit3.text: Local models, no restricted tokens or pay-per-use costs.

hero.title: Modular Architecture
hero.subtitle: Sentra Brain combines LLM serving, secure integrations, document search, automations, and full control in one system.

callout.title: Data stays inside your perimeter.

accounting.title: Accounting & Administrative Service Firms
accounting.intro: Accounting and administrative service firms handle sensitive financial and personal data every day—tax filings, payroll, and compliance paperwork. These tasks are repetitive, highly regulated, and cannot be delegated to cloud-based AI without risking client confidentiality. Sentra runs entirely on your infrastructure, bringing automation and AI directly to your office.

challenges.title: Key Challenges
challenges.tax: Managing and filing complex tax returns for multiple clients under strict deadlines
challenges.payroll: Processing payroll while complying with evolving labor laws
challenges.forms: Handling large volumes of government and compliance forms
challenges.confidential: Protecting sensitive client financial and personal information
